chunks: From him, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

He was asked about a man who frees his female slave by manumission from the back (i.e., upon his death or at a specified time); may he have sexual relations with her if he wishes, or marry her, or sell her service during her life? He said: Yes, whatever he wishes he may do.

key_terms.عَنْ دُبُرٍ: Manumission from the back; a type of conditional manumission where the slave becomes free upon the owner's death.
key_terms.يَطَؤُهَا: He has sexual relations with her (consummation).

ai.seo_question: What rights does an owner have over a female slave freed upon his death (Mudabbir) before she is fully free?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the 'Mudabbir' retains the status of a slave until the owner's actual death, granting the owner full discretion to consummate relations, marry her, or sell her service during the interim period. This ruling highlights the distinct legal category of the Mudabbir compared to other forms of manumission, emphasizing that the conditional freedom is not immediate but deferred. The ruling underscores the owner's rights over the slave's body and labor while the condition for freedom remains unfulfilled.
